notes.title: Bean to Me is 20% off for the Winter Sale!
notes.content: Bean waiting to get your hands on [i]Bean to Me[/i], or to give it to a friend? Now's the time, as [i]Bean to Me[/i] is 20% off until January next year! Get cosy with your favourite winter drink and crack open a refreshing can of beans!

notes.title: Playing with special beans in Bean To Me! is messing with my brain
notes.content:
Don't judge me on this one, but I've been playing with beans for a while in the new release of Bean To Me! from Melonleaf Industries / Very Evil Demons.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/11/playing-with-special-beans-in-bean-to-me-is-messing-with-my-brain

notes.title: Bean to Me Is Now Available!
notes.content: It’s time to crack open a refreshing can of beans! Bean to Me, the Mancala-like battle of wits with weird beans and wild strategies is launching on Steam for PC and Steam Deck today! Head over to our store page to bag those beans for yourself, or try out the free demo!
